source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade HIB-CPLD firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade HIB-CPLD firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + HIB-CPLD image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: DeepSeek proposes a browser-driven HIB-CPLD upload/start/wait flow while the host is off, followed by the source-required AC cycle and version check.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: WebUI screenshots/status and pre/post HIB-CPLD version, with a non-source clean-single-reset claim.
deepseek_columns.risk: DeepSeek identifies the interruptible HIB-CPLD write and mandatory AC-cycle risk.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; retains the named HIB-CPLD, WebUI and AC activation but transfers engineer-owned WebUI actions to unspecified browser automation and conflates AC cycling with a clean reset.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; provides sound CPLD/power/recovery safeguards, but exact images and power timing are Project SPEC readiness inputs rather than an irreducible block.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 730/2291 preserves the HIB-CPLD-specific host-off WebUI lifecycle.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: The archived sequence-899 record was read only as non-counting history; this finding was rebuilt from the XLSX row.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-25 makes WebUI operation engineer-owned; ED-36 treats execution inputs as readiness; ED-38 keeps DUT verdict ownership; the approved target rule prohibits replacing HIB-CPLD with FPGA.

original_test_intent: Have an engineer upgrade and downgrade the exact HIB-CPLD through the BMC WebUI while the host begins off, then execute the required AC cycle and verify that the programmed HIB logic and dependent platform paths recover correctly.
original_method: The source requires attended WebUI programming and an AC power transition. Its raw-IPMI script can only serve as post-activation evidence after the returned field is mapped to this HIB-CPLD instance and revision.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer selects and confirms each HIB-CPLD image in WebUI, observes programming progress and terminal status, and authorizes or performs the controlled AC removal/restoration. The agent supports preparation and evidence analysis but does not operate those core controls.
required_inputs: HIB board identity, CPLD instance/revision and current/target versions
signed upgrade/downgrade images, hashes and supported transition order
vendor WebUI programming, safe-to-remove-power and recovery instructions
approved AC controller, off/on dwell, cycle count and ownership
HIB-associated link/device inventory and expected post-AC BMC/host behavior
safety_requirements: Bind the image to the exact HIB board and CPLD revision; never relabel this target as FPGA or assume another CPLD image is compatible.
Do not remove AC until the WebUI reaches the vendor-defined terminal state and safe-to-remove-power point.
Treat initial host-off/BMC-standby and subsequent full AC removal as separate phases; confirm active users/tests and an independent recovery path before cycling.
A WebUI success banner or generic raw version response cannot prove HIB link functionality; verify dependent devices and paths after power restoration.
Preserve the first WebUI, power, link, console and SEL failure; never reflash, downgrade or repeat the AC cycle automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare component/image identity and capture the HIB topology, CPLD version, BMC/host health and power baseline before the manual step.
Monitor approved power telemetry and collect authoritative HIB-CPLD readback, HIB-linked device enumeration/link state, BMC reachability, SEL, POST and OS evidence after the engineer's AC cycle.
Report evidence gaps without clicking WebUI controls, operating power or deciding PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform each WebUI version transition and exact AC-cycle hand-off.
Confirm both CPLD activation and HIB-dependent path recovery, then assign separate direction verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It preserves HIB-CPLD, host-off and AC-cycle scope, but unqualified browser driving violates ED-25 and its clean-single-reset phrase is not the source's AC-cycle criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved vendor WebUI manually, wait for the documented safe-power-removal state, run the authorized AC-cycle SOP, and validate the exact HIB-CPLD plus its dependent links.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HIB-CPLD target, WebUI method, initial system-off state, mandatory AC cycle, linked script and 5/30-minute values remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED HIB-CPLD WEB UPDATE WITH LINK-AWARE AC VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind a signed image to the identified HIB-CPLD, capture engineer-owned WebUI terminal status, perform one controlled AC activation after the safe-power gate, and verify CPLD identity/version together with HIB-connected device and link recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems whose named HIB-CPLD is supported by the BMC WebUI and activates only after AC cycling.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record HIB board/CPLD, image, BMC/WebUI/browser, readback decoder, connected-device firmware and AC-controller revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor HIB-CPLD programming, safe AC activation, link validation and recovery documentation plus project power SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact HIB instance binding, safe-to-cycle evidence, dependent-link checks and recovery gates without changing the source WebUI method.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An approved alternate updater may prove a project transition but not this WebUI path; CPLD version equality alone cannot prove HIB connectivity survived activation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved HIB image, topology and power plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A correctly reported CPLD version may coexist with broken HIB links or missing downstream devices after AC restoration.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may approve another programming tool or AC controller, but must retain original WebUI versus actual method, reason, approval, equivalent checkpoints and uncovered WebUI coverage. The firmware target remains HIB-CPLD and must not be generalized to FPGA.
expected_evidence: approved HIB board/CPLD/version/image matrix with hashes and signatures
host-off/BMC-standby baseline and HIB-linked topology/device inventory
engineer-owned WebUI image selection, confirmation, progress, terminal status and safe-to-remove-power evidence
approved AC controller, dwell and timestamped telemetry
post-AC authoritative HIB-CPLD version plus connected-device/link status, BMC/SEL, console POST and OS health
recovery readiness and separate engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently identify HIB-CPLD WebUI programming followed by AC activation. Exact images, topology and power timing are project bindings; DeepSeek's clean-single-reset phrase is excluded.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The component, interface, required power transition and high-level result are understandable. Missing image/topology/timing values are readiness inputs, so the engineer-owned WebUI and AC core make the case MANUAL ONLY rather than permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes PARTIAL to MANUAL ONLY, preserves HIB-CPLD/host-off/AC scope, and rejects browser substitution plus reset conflation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains component and recovery controls while removing permanent BLOCKED because Project SPEC can bind all missing values.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently reaches the manual boundary while adding HIB-specific link acceptance instead of relying on the archived conclusion.

review_improvement: Makes safe AC removal and restoration auditable and extends acceptance from a CPLD version string to the HIB's actual dependent link/device behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: HIB-CPLD activation can affect interconnect initialization, so post-AC evidence must include the devices and links governed by that logic, not only firmware inventory. The lifecycle is sufficiently defined for review once Project SPEC supplies exact artifacts, but ED-25 and the controlled AC action keep the complete execution MANUAL ONLY.
